description.value: Oh Sweet Day! is a Metro Vancouver bakery known for custom cakes, mini cheesecakes, and decorated shortbread cookies, all baked fresh to order. They specialize in wedding cakes, birthday cakes, and corporate event desserts with a modern buttercream style. A touring cyclist could stop in to pick up cookies, tarts, or cupcakes for the road.

address.value: 1706 E 1st Ave, Vancouver, BC V5N 1B1, Canada
